dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you get the Koholasaurus to close its mouth?

dialogues.speaker: Tuksina
dialogues.text: Huh? Do you think it looks a little inelegant, gawking like that? Haha, sure, I'll get the lil' guy's mouth closed, just give me a moment...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you get the Koholasaurus to open its mouth?

dialogues.speaker: Tuksina
dialogues.text: Huh? Do you think it looks grumpy with its mouth closed? Haha, sure, I'll get the lil' guy's mouth open, just give me a moment...

dialogues.speaker: Tuksina
dialogues.text: #Oh, it's you, {NICKNAME}! Thank you for all your help earlier. Just tell me if you need anything, and I'll see it gets sorted.
